prerequisite.name: Research Runtime Weekly
prerequisite.reason: The scorecard contract requires weekly scoring after Sunday Weekly synthesis completes. The latest Weekly Runtime is still Running, so this Draft preserves completed article-level review work without replacing the prior Completed scorecard.

reasonLegend.e: 依据来源可追溯性、事实与判断分离、限制及反证处理评估。
reasonLegend.o: 依据是否形成非平凡判断、机制解释及证据边界评估。
reasonLegend.s: 依据研究问题、论证路径、章节组织与可读性评估。
reasonLegend.u: 依据是否形成可执行设计、验证方法、边界或下一步决策评估。

editorialNote.zh: 把动作、授权、执行、状态和验收拆成独立环节，控制边界清楚；不足是来源集中在少量平台案例，对不同交互环境的适用性验证还不够。
editorialNote.en: It cleanly separates action, authority, execution, state, and acceptance; the evidence base is still concentrated in a small set of platform examples, leaving broader interaction environments under-tested.

editorialNote.zh: 控制面与工作运行时的分层完整，接口和中小企业落地路径具体；但与相邻治理文章概念重叠较多，独立的新证据和案例还可加强。
editorialNote.en: The control-plane/runtime layering and SME implementation path are concrete; however, it overlaps conceptually with adjacent governance notes and would benefit from more independent evidence and cases.

editorialNote.zh: 抓住 OSWorld 中 Evaluator 对执行结果验证的核心价值，并清楚限定版本和外推范围；不足是尚未把评测机制接到真实企业任务的失败与验收链路。
editorialNote.en: It correctly centers OSWorld on evaluator-backed execution verification and states version and extrapolation limits; the missing step is connecting that mechanism to real enterprise failure and acceptance chains.

editorialNote.zh: 用多家企业产品交叉说明“岗位先于 Agent”的组织视角，判断有价值；但材料仍以厂商资料为主，真实岗位重构和长期运营证据不足。
editorialNote.en: The cross-vendor comparison makes the position-before-agent argument useful; the evidence remains vendor-heavy, with limited observation of real job redesign and long-running operations.

editorialNote.zh: 完成合同把数据、版本差异、反证和可迁移边界连成一个可验证模型，论证很强；不足是跨框架统一验证器的实现成本和误判率仍缺实测。
editorialNote.en: The completion contract tightly connects data, version differences, counterevidence, and transfer boundaries into a verifiable model; implementation cost and false-positive behavior of a cross-framework verifier remain unmeasured.

editorialNote.zh: 把“声明完成”和“可验证完成”区分得简洁有效，适合作为治理入门框架；但关键数据和论证较多留在上游研究对象，单篇自足性不足。
editorialNote.en: The distinction between claimed and verifiable completion is concise and useful as a governance frame; too much of the supporting data and reasoning remains upstream, weakening standalone completeness.

editorialNote.zh: “依赖就绪不等于授权就绪”的判断有洞察，工作图与治理状态分离明确；不足是直接失败案例较少，关键证据仍较依赖上游对象。
editorialNote.en: The insight that dependency-ready is not authority-ready is strong and the graph/governance split is clear; direct failure cases are sparse and key evidence remains dependent on upstream objects.

editorialNote.zh: 把历史耐久与当前权威耐久分开，并用投影过期和反例解释重新准入的必要性；不足是统一运行状态仍主要是架构推导，跨系统实证有限。
editorialNote.en: It usefully separates durable history from durable authority and explains re-admission through stale projections and counterexamples; the unified runtime state remains mostly architectural inference with limited cross-system evidence.

editorialNote.zh: 把预算从计费指标提升为运行时准入状态，暂停与恢复边界设计得很实用；不足是证据来源较单一，复杂预算冲突和多人审批尚未验证。
editorialNote.en: Treating budget as a runtime admission state makes pause and resume operationally useful; the evidence is narrow, and complex budget conflicts or multi-party approvals are not yet validated.

editorialNote.zh: 把撤销、Worker 停止、租约和副作用补偿拆开，恢复语义非常清楚；不足是分布式延迟与外部效果一致性仍缺真实故障数据。
editorialNote.en: The separation of revocation, worker stopping, leases, and side-effect compensation is precise; distributed delay and external-effect consistency still lack real fault data.

editorialNote.zh: 把轨道从状态机和 PM 判断中剥离，只负责事实、调度、审计和机械拒绝，并补足 policy bundle 与并发边界，体系更完整；不足是关键 V1.9.7 证据仍来自私有候选实现，外部复现有限。
editorialNote.en: It sharply separates the rail from lifecycle state and PM judgment, while adding policy-bundle and concurrency boundaries; decisive V1.9.7 evidence still comes from a private candidate implementation, limiting external reproduction.

editorialNote.zh: 用真实 FunctionResponse 被合成输入遮蔽的恢复缺陷说明“更晚不等于更有权威”，并把 precedence 放到模型前；不足是回归仍非完整持久 HITL，多中断与授权身份未验证。
editorialNote.en: The concrete FunctionResponse shadowing defect shows why later context is not necessarily more authoritative and moves precedence before model interpretation; the regression is not a full durable HITL loop and does not cover multiple interruptions or approver identity.

editorialNote.zh: 把重复终态识别为旧事实重入，并用消费状态与因果同步测试固定仲裁顺序，论证扎实；不足是只覆盖一种 guardrail/turn-limit 竞态，尚未证明通用终态仲裁。
editorialNote.en: It treats repeated terminal failure as old evidence re-entering the system and uses consumed-state plus causal synchronization to define arbitration; the evidence covers one guardrail/turn-limit race rather than a general terminal-arbitration mechanism.

editorialNote.zh: 把配置优先级与谁有资格进入配置竞争分开，且用 broker 开关验证权威面收缩，边界清楚；不足是仍局限于一个 Codex 凭据路径，跨环境策略传播尚未实测。
editorialNote.en: It separates precedence from eligibility to participate in configuration and uses the broker switch to demonstrate authority contraction; evidence remains limited to one Codex credential path, without cross-environment policy-propagation tests.

editorialNote.zh: 把真实 gate 误拒、分层回归失败与 GitHub MCP 调用时 scope challenge 串成任务级授权证据链，工程证据很强；不足是 Authorization Receipt 仍属模型提案，未覆盖全部工具和外部效果。
editorialNote.en: It connects a real gate misclassification, layered regression failures, and a GitHub MCP call-time scope challenge into a task-level authorization evidence chain; the Authorization Receipt remains a proposed model and has not been validated across all tools or external effects.

editorialNote.zh: 用 CrewAI 假绿 telemetry 与 CodeFlowMu 报告投影缺陷交叉说明执行、交付、验收和历史必须分账，案例链完整；不足是仍缺从工具失败到正式验收的端到端跨层追踪实验。
editorialNote.en: CrewAI false-green telemetry and a CodeFlowMu report-projection defect jointly show why execution, delivery, acceptance, and history need separate records; an end-to-end cross-layer experiment from tool failure through formal acceptance is still missing.

editorialNote.zh: 把后台任务是否仍由父流程负责转成终态屏障，并用成功、失败、interrupt 回归覆盖关键分支；不足是只证明内存内在途任务，崩溃恢复和外部效果仍无闭环。
editorialNote.en: It turns ownership of background work into a terminal barrier and covers success, failure, and interrupt paths with regressions; the evidence concerns in-memory in-flight tasks, leaving crash recovery and external effects unresolved.

editorialNote.zh: 把观察、注意、裁决和生命周期写入拆成四种权力，并用真实 EVAL 缺陷和 Anywhere Agents 交叉校准，证据丰富；不足是自动 reconcile 的 SLA 与统一运行机制仍未被实现证明。
editorialNote.en: It separates observation, attention, adjudication, and lifecycle mutation into four powers and cross-checks a real EVAL defect with Anywhere Agents; the evidence is rich, but a unified unattended reconciliation mechanism and SLA remain unproven.

editorialNote.zh: 用 OpenHands 健康假象和 CodeFlowMu 恢复时间线区分健康、活性、准入与因果前置，且保留时间顺序无法证明因果的反证；不足是历史 QA 放行仍缺可绑定的 prerequisite receipt。
editorialNote.en: The OpenHands health illusion and CodeFlowMu recovery timeline clearly separate health, liveness, admission, and causal prerequisites while preserving the limits of temporal order; historical QA release still lacks a bindable prerequisite receipt.

editorialNote.zh: 用 Anywhere Agents 四轮反例和可重跑 Windows 探针把取消、进程退出、树级 containment 与重派资格逐层拆开，证据边界很强；不足是任意深度后代和跨平台 containment 仍未证明。
editorialNote.en: Four Anywhere Agents counterexamples plus a rerunnable Windows probe separate cancellation, process exit, tree containment, and redispatch eligibility with strong evidence boundaries; arbitrary-depth descendants and cross-platform containment remain unproven.

editorialNote.zh: 从 Sutando 的 collaborator 反例推导 UI 状态必须声明来源、对象、时效和冲突策略，并提供五类公开复现夹具；不足是公开 reader 仍不是完整生产 UI 与权限链的端到端验证。
editorialNote.en: A Sutando collaborator counterexample motivates status projections that declare source, object, freshness, and conflict policy, backed by five public fixtures; the public reader is still not an end-to-end validation of a production UI and authority chain.

editorialNote.zh: 用 Claude Code 过早 Running 的具体故障说明状态标签一旦触发消费者行为就成为证据契约，层次划分清楚；不足是依据仅为官方 release note，真实 readiness 门槛和回归细节未公开。
editorialNote.en: The Claude Code premature-Running defect shows that a status label becomes an evidence contract once consumers act on it; the argument is clear, but the source is an official release note without public readiness criteria or regression details.

editorialNote.zh: 把资源消费来源与根目标预算归属分成两种身份，并覆盖嵌套、卸载和 checkpoint 并发，机制完整；不足是 token 账本不能推出即时撤销、跨主机一致性或通用配额。
editorialNote.en: It separates the source of resource consumption from the root objective that owns the budget and covers nesting, unloading, and checkpoint concurrency; a token ledger does not prove immediate revocation, cross-host consistency, or general quota enforcement.

editorialNote.zh: 把完整快照的重建资格与当前执行授权拆成两道门，并用 seed、lineage、compaction 反例限定恢复边界；不足是仅有一个 Codex 状态路径，外部资源撤销与跨主机一致性未验证。
editorialNote.en: It separates reconstructability of a complete snapshot from current execution authority and uses seed, lineage, and compaction counterexamples to bound recovery; evidence is one Codex state path, without external-resource revocation or cross-host consistency tests.

editorialNote.zh: 把 workflow frame、call occurrence、branch 与 replay 决策组合成恢复身份，解决嵌套 HITL 的历史歧义；不足是 responder 身份和外部副作用仍需独立证据，不能由 event 匹配替代。
editorialNote.en: It combines workflow frame, call occurrence, branch, and replay decision into a recovery identity that resolves nested HITL ambiguity; responder identity and external side effects still require independent evidence rather than event matching.

editorialNote.zh: 把路径状态、迁移历史、REPORT、验收、并发 claim 与版本前置统一放进一条任务生命周期，边界和反例都很细；不足是多 Runtime 争用与 revision token 的真实闭环仍未实测。
editorialNote.en: It unifies path state, transition history, reports, acceptance, claim contention, and revision preconditions in one task lifecycle with careful counterexamples; real multi-runtime contention and revision-token closure remain untested.

editorialNote.zh: 用一项工作贯穿 TMPA 治理、FCoP 状态和 CodeFlowMu 执行，并把 unknown、wait、deny 与 business decision 分得清楚；不足是关键 rail contract 仍来自私有 V1.9.7 候选，外部复现性有限。
editorialNote.en: One work item cleanly connects TMPA governance, FCoP state, and CodeFlowMu execution while separating unknown, wait, deny, and business decisions; the key rail contract still comes from a private V1.9.7 candidate, limiting external reproduction.

editorialNote.zh: 把去重提升为生命周期所有权准入不变量，并把集合语义、锁与外部 exactly-once 分层说明，论证更准确；不足是 Python equality 仍可能误合并不同资源，跨进程资源唯一性未解决。
editorialNote.en: It elevates deduplication into a lifecycle-ownership admission invariant and separates population semantics, locking, and external exactly-once claims; Python equality can still collapse distinct resources, and cross-process uniqueness remains unresolved.

editorialNote.zh: 把取消视为延迟传播的控制流，同时让所有已接管资源完成有界 teardown，兼顾调用者与所有者契约；不足是普通 close 异常被 best-effort 抑制，远端清理成功仍无证据。
editorialNote.en: It models cancellation as delayed control flow while requiring bounded teardown of owned resources, balancing caller and owner contracts; ordinary close errors are best-effort suppressed and remote cleanup success still lacks authoritative evidence.

editorialNote.zh: 把路径发现明确降级为获取写锁前的临时证据，并在获得权限后重新发现和读取，TOCTOU 边界处理准确；不足是仍只覆盖本地文件迁移，分布式租约和多写者身份冲突未解决。
editorialNote.en: It correctly demotes path discovery to provisional evidence before acquiring write authority and re-discovers under the lock, closing a TOCTOU boundary; the mechanism remains local-file specific and does not solve distributed leases or multi-writer identity conflicts.

editorialNote.zh: 按可变请求容器与共享 live client 的所有权差异实施 copy-on-mutation，既避开深拷贝崩溃也防止顶层串写；不足是嵌套可变对象和 client 内部状态仍可跨请求泄漏。
editorialNote.en: Copy-on-mutation follows the ownership difference between mutable request containers and a shared live client, avoiding deep-copy failure and top-level cross-request writes; nested mutable objects and client-internal state can still leak across requests.

editorialNote.zh: 把十份历史 REPORT 的归属问题一路推进到 V2.0.4 动态诊断，并用同一 QA 任务 active→review 的实屏变化验证语义，工程闭环很完整；不足是关键能力仍以自有系统证据为主，跨项目复现有限。
editorialNote.en: It carries a ten-report attribution problem through to V2.0.4 live diagnostics and validates the same QA task changing from active to review in the UI, forming a strong engineering loop; the decisive evidence remains first-party, with limited cross-project reproduction.

editorialNote.zh: 先由 Host 记录真实技能调用，再用 canonical trusted root 验证 provenance，能阻止仓库文本和 symlink 冒充用户来源；不足是路径只证明来源，不证明内容版本、安全性或当前审批。
editorialNote.en: Host-recorded skill invocation plus canonical trusted-root checks prevent repository text or symlinks from impersonating user provenance; a trusted path proves origin only, not content version, safety, or current approval.

editorialNote.zh: 把缓存低风险结果绑定到授权版本，并在真正 fast-approve 前再次核对，准确关闭并发撤销竞态；不足是版本 tuple 只覆盖已编码的权威事实，外部政策和 effect-time 竞态仍存在。
editorialNote.en: Binding cached low-risk results to authorization identity and rechecking before fast approval precisely closes a concurrent-revocation race; the version tuple covers only encoded authority facts, leaving external policy and effect-time races.

editorialNote.zh: 把 timeout 的责任边界扩展到进程组，并让超时与取消共享有界 TERM→KILL→drain 清理，生命周期语义完整；不足是 POSIX 进程组不等于任意进程树，更不覆盖远程任务和外部效果。
editorialNote.en: It extends timeout responsibility to the process group and gives timeout and cancellation one bounded TERM→KILL→drain lifecycle; a POSIX process group is not an arbitrary process tree and says nothing about remote jobs or external effects.

editorialNote.zh: 把 delta checkpoint 的耐久性与 seed、写入顺序、reducer 和迁移组成的 replay 完整性分开，直接指出 keep-latest 的危险；不足是存储收益来自供应商模拟，恢复成本和生产故障仍缺独立实测。
editorialNote.en: It separates delta-checkpoint durability from replay integrity across seed, write order, reducer, and migration, exposing the danger of naive keep-latest retention; storage gains are vendor-simulated and recovery cost plus production failures lack independent measurement.

editorialNote.zh: 把 creation source、resume 稳定性和 fork lineage 分成不同 provenance 轴，并明确兼容默认不是历史事实，模型完整；不足是 Feature 标签由应用自报，仍缺认证主体和防篡改审计绑定。
editorialNote.en: It separates creation source, resume stability, and fork lineage into distinct provenance axes and correctly treats compatibility defaults as interpretations rather than history; Feature labels are application-asserted and still lack authenticated-principal or tamper-evident bindings.

editorialNote.zh: 用 child-only developer instruction 的实际请求边界说明 provenance 与 authority 必须分开，父子排除与单次表示测试清楚；不足是调用者授权、重放与 compaction 后的权威连续性仍未证明。
editorialNote.en: The child-only developer-instruction boundary cleanly separates provenance from authority and tests parent exclusion plus single representation; caller authorization, replay behavior, and authority continuity after compaction remain unproven.

editorialNote.zh: 把不确定 Session append 持久化成待对账状态，并在下一次模型调用前通过 authoritative history 三分法解决，恢复门设计扎实；不足是仍无分布式 CAS，也不能覆盖外部工具 exactly-once。
editorialNote.en: It persists an uncertain Session append as recoverable reconciliation state and resolves it with a three-way authoritative-history test before another model call; there is still no distributed CAS and no exactly-once guarantee for external tools.

editorialNote.zh: 用 289 条失败轨迹和三专家分歧证明单一 rootCause 会压扁诊断证据，并把 plural hypotheses 与 repair decision 分开，学术支撑强；不足是 benchmark 未证明多视角诊断能提升真实高风险事故修复率。
editorialNote.en: Using 289 failed traces and three-expert disagreement, it strongly shows why a single rootCause can erase diagnostic evidence and separates plural hypotheses from repair decisions; the benchmark does not yet show that multi-perspective diagnosis improves repair quality in real high-risk incidents.

editorialNote.zh: 把 MCP 权限归属绑定到具体 attachment/runtime，而非共享 server 身份或线程环境，并在缺失权威时拒绝 call preparation；不足是已准备调用的即时撤销和跨进程 profile 一致性尚无保证。
editorialNote.en: It binds MCP permission authority to the specific attachment/runtime rather than shared server identity or ambient thread context and refuses call preparation when authority is absent; live revocation of prepared calls and cross-process profile consistency remain unproven.

editorialNote.zh: Host 先删除请求方 entitlement，再用当前账户和多项 capability 谓词签发上下文，能切断自我授权路径；不足是下游插件如何解释 verified/unknown 仍是独立责任，端到端执行权未证明。
editorialNote.en: The host removes caller entitlement claims before minting context from current account state and conjunctive capability predicates, cutting the self-authorization path; downstream interpretation of verified/unknown remains a separate responsibility and end-to-end execution authority is not proved.

editorialNote.zh: 把缓存可读性与当前政策的授权可接受性分开，明确强制刷新时 stale fallback 不能继续放权，治理判断很清楚；不足是只有官方 changelog，没有鉴权、版本绑定和在途撤销的实现级证据。
editorialNote.en: It cleanly separates cache readability from authority admissibility and makes stale fallback non-authorizing under forced refresh; the evidence is an official changelog, without implementation-level proof of authentication, revision binding, or in-flight revocation.

editorialNote.zh: 把 workspace trust 从 UI 标签落实为 capability materialization 前的配置过滤，并让 unknown/malformed 失效关闭，执行边界明确；不足是只能证明新能力的准入收缩，已有对象的 live revocation 尚未覆盖。
editorialNote.en: It turns workspace trust from a UI label into configuration filtering before capability materialization and fails closed on unknown or malformed trust; this proves admission contraction for new capabilities, not live revocation of existing objects.

editorialNote.zh: 用真实与伪造专业面板几乎同样提升 commitment 的实验把展示形式与行动资格分开，外置 gate 的论证直接；不足是新 preprint 尚无独立复现，ANSWER commitment 也不等同真实工具副作用。
editorialNote.en: The experiment showing similar commitment under real and fabricated professional panels cleanly separates presentation from action qualification and motivates an external gate; the new preprint lacks independent replication and ANSWER commitment is not equivalent to a real tool side effect.

editorialNote.zh: 把二十一篇材料收敛成 transfer 与 transformation 两阶段都必须保留 authority lineage，并逐类落到缓存、恢复、凭据与身份，综合很强；不足是 Provenance-Preserving Admission 仍缺跨机制统一实现和基准验证。
editorialNote.en: It synthesizes twenty-one notes into an authority-lineage requirement across both transfer and transformation, then grounds it in caching, resume, credentials, and identity; Provenance-Preserving Admission still lacks a unified cross-mechanism implementation and benchmark.
